neighborhoods.name: 13th arrondissement — Station F / Bibliothèque François-Mitterrand / Quartier de la Gare
neighborhoods.rationale: This is the actual 2025-2026 gravity well for builder-scale AI events: Station F hosted the AI Tinkerers × Anthropic AI Agents Hackathon (Feb 16 2025), GOSIM AI Paris 2025 and GOSIM Paris 2026 (May), the OpenAI AI Privacy Hackathon (Sep 3 2026), AI Engineer Paris 2026 (Sep 23-24 — literally the week after your date), plus recurring AICamp/Vikit dev meetups at Station F's Founders Café, so the Founders Café / Station F Open Platform and the surrounding Bibliothèque / Tolbiac blocks are pre-vetted for a bilingual 50-200 coffee/hack day.

avoid_too: Neon Noir itself is invite-only / member-led — great seed, hard to book externally, and capacity is closer to 100 than 200
The Hoxton Sentier bar and the classic Silicon Sentier cafés are VC-meeting-sized (20-40) and meme-status — they will not take a real 50-200 hack-day buyout

neighborhoods.name: 9th arrondissement — Le Peletier / Grands Boulevards / Folies Bergère (edge of Silicon Sentier)
neighborhoods.rationale: Neon Noir (14 rue Le Peletier, 75009), the ZML/UMA/Drysdale builder community space, hosted the {TECH:EUROPE} Paris AI Hackathon (Feb 7 2026), an NVIDIA Open Source Developer Meetup (Feb 2026), a GPU MODE × PyTorch IRL hackathon (Apr 2026), Paris hardware meetups and a RAISE Summit hackathon satellite in 2025-2026, and dotJS 2026 lands at the Folies Bergère on literally Sep 18 2026 — your exact date — so this is where the bilingual dev/AI crowd will already be, with The Hoxton Sentier a stone's throw away for spillover.

avoid_too: It's a big open food-hall format — sound bleed is real, and dedicated quiet hacking rooms are smaller (Chaufferie / Gallery sub-spaces cap around 250) so plan plenary vs hack zones separately

neighborhoods.name: 12th arrondissement — Gare de Lyon / Ground Control
neighborhoods.rationale: Ground Control (81 rue du Charolais, 75012) hosted AI Tinkerers Paris's Summer Networking Meetup (130+ RSVPs, Jul 17 2025) and the Back2school Apéro (Sep 5 2025) — the exact coffee/apéro-meets-builder format you're running — and the venue is built for it: ~4,500 m² indoors + 2,500 m² terrace, multiple bookable sub-spaces (La Chaufferie, la Galerie, Passage de la Chaufferie), bars, food stalls and a proven 100-200 tech crowd.
